name: RMG Lab
summary:
Welcome to the RMG Simulation App, your gateway to innovation and cutting-edge solutions! Designed specifically for RMG's Innovation Lab, this application leverages the power of immersive technologies to revolutionize the way we simulate, analyze, and solve real-world challenges.

Key Features
Realistic Simulations: Experience highly detailed and interactive simulations tailored to your business needs.
Innovative Solutions Testing: Experiment with new ideas and strategies in a controlled virtual environment
